p9-spell:v1.governanceNote: Accepted in P9 cycle2 baseline for immediate single-target DICE damage/healing with Elemental Spheres, Musical Notes, and Devotion Gauge.

authored-immediate:v1.governanceNote: Accepted in P14-A1..A6 baselines for room-admitted Wizard single-target immediate damage/healing (plus creature self-healing in A6).

authored-condition:v1.governanceNote: Accepted in P14-A7..A9 baselines for room-admitted Wizard single-target canonical Stunned with gm-manual expiry.

authored-effect:v1.governanceNote: Unaccepted active source work (Opus P14-A10). Present in working-tree source files, but has NO completed increment/App/review acceptance handoff (Cross-Track Finding I4). Must not be marked production-ready.

nonReusableValidatorInterfaces.boundaryReason: Requires a live seeded multiplayer server room (room.combatState, room.tokens, room.characterStates, room.players, room.authoredAbilityApprovals, room.installedDefinitionRegistry) and active socket/turn-clock context. Its pure definition, formula, effect, and self-healing helpers ARE reused directly from server/shared/services/authoredAbility.js, server/shared/services/authoredEffect.js, and server/services/installedDefinitionRegistry.js.

Requires live browser Zustand stores (gameStore, characterStore, combatStore, partyStore), active map token placement, roomRevision, and live player dice roll state. Its pure shape, payment, formula, hash, and catalogue-lookup helpers (supportShape, planClassPayment, readFormula, supportSpell, definitionHash) ARE reused directly.

Requires live character inventory state and room-admitted definition maps in gameStore.admittedDefinitionsById. The underlying Wizard definition validator (definitionFromWizard + compileDefinition) IS reused directly.

nonReusableValidatorInterfaces.module: Non-existent execution validators (AoE, saves, buffs/debuffs, DoT/HoT/shields, summons/transforms, reactions/triggers, passives)
nonReusableValidatorInterfaces.boundaryReason: No production execution validator exists for these mechanics because Mythrill intentionally gates them as manual tabletop adjudication outside p9-spell:v1 and P14 authored-immediate/condition:v1 (with authored-effect:v1 still in unaccepted source). Per instructions, no competing validator or execution engine was built.

schema-instant-duration-envelope.detail: durationConfig ({"durationType":"instant","durationValue":0,"durationUnit":"instant"}) has instant semantics but includes extra schema keys beyond canonical {"durationType":"instant"}.

self-target-schema-or-route.detail: targetingConfig.targetingType is "self" (single-actor self target; P9 supportShape requires targetingType: "single" with targetRestrictions: ["self"], and P14-A6 supports creatureSelfHealing only on single-target healing).
